name: PublishPage
description: Publish or update a page in the Static Azure DevOps extension.
author: f-steff

inputs.name: page
inputs.label: Page slug (enables publishing a page)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Slug of the page to create or update. Set this to publish a page; leave empty to publish only a build tab (set 'tabName').

inputs.name: comment
inputs.label: Comment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comment stored on the page (shown in the hub).

inputs.name: tabName
inputs.label: Report tab name (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: When set, the page is also attached to the build so it appears under a 'Static page' tab in the build results. Leave empty for no tab.

inputs.name: createIfMissing
inputs.label: Create the page if it does not exist

inputs.name: accessToken
inputs.label: Access token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Requires 'Allow scripts to access the OAuth token' on the pipeline.

inputs.name: chunkSizeKb
inputs.label: Chunk size (KiB, compressed)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum compressed bytes per stored document. Must keep the base64 document below the service limit (~5 MiB).
